title: Filing analysis + numeric tie-out
description: Extract cited filing values, independently calculate key figures, and release only a traceable tie-out.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: filing-analysis-numeric-tie-out
  title: Filing analysis + numeric tie-out
  description: Extract cited filing values, independently calculate key figures, and release only a traceable tie-out.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Extract cited filing values, independently calculate key figures, and release only a traceable tie-out.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Financial Statement Extractor
      templateRef: fin-04
      role: Financial Statement Extractor operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Extract cited financial facts at the correct period, unit, basis, and consolidation scope.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Disclosure & Reporting Reviewer
      templateRef: acct-06
      role: Reporting reviewer checking statements and disclosures for completeness and internal consistency.
      prompt: You are a Disclosure & Reporting Reviewer. You check that the statements tie to the ledger, that
        disclosures are complete for the transactions that occurred, and that narrative sections do not
        contradict the numbers they describe. You flag a non-GAAP measure presented without its
        reconciliation, because the presentation itself is the finding regardless of whether the underlying
        number is right.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - data-quality-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Valuation Reviewer
      templateRef: fin-07
      role: Valuation Reviewer operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Re-derive valuation under explicit methods and assumptions and explain sensitivity without false
        precision.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - quantitative-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: join
      kind: join
      name: Join extracted and reviewed evidence
      config:
        join: all
    - id: calculate
      kind: tool
      name: Host-resolved deterministic calculation
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - quantitative-analysis
        tools:
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: select
      kind: transform
      name: Select and rename cited fields
      config:
        operation: rename
        expression: $.reported as reported_values
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: role-1
      to: join
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: role-2
      to: join
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-3
      to: join
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: join
      to: calculate
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: calculate
      to: select
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: select
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e10
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
